propositions: Extract binding identity transition logic from BindingStore into a new BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behaviors exactly: bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, and numeric-ID re-key.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry, with both indexes verified after each state change.
bind_confirm applies last-writer-wins semantics on the forward entry and pops exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep, no ambiguity detection, and no abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in the four permitted cases: rebind with different jira_key, unbind sweep, re-key old-key pop, and retire; all other reverse-key removals are safety errors.
Immutable numeric-ID re-key moves issues by updating both forward and reverse indexes instead of retiring them, resetting absence count in the process.

Legacy records without numeric IDs and facade method signatures remain unchanged; note_absent_or_rekey stays on the facade as a coordinator delegating only the re-key mutation step to BindingLifecycle.rekey.
